description: Use this when the user asks what a UAE tax invoice must show, the difference between a full and a simplified tax invoice, or which kind a sale needs. Lists what a UAE tax invoice must show under Article 59 of the VAT Executive Regulation, for a full or a simplified tax invoice, with the clause for each item and when it must be issued. Give the customer's VAT status and the amount in AED (and reverse_charge if it applies) to get which kind the law allows; otherwise the full tax invoice is returned. The result states the law and, separately, Fatura Go's practice (a full tax invoice above AED 10,000); mention both when they differ. Do not use it to check one specific invoice for e-invoicing fields (check_einvoicing_readiness) or to make an invoice (create_draft_invoice).

invoice_kind.description: Default auto: decided from the other fields.

total_aed.description: The supply amount in AED, VAT included.
